title: Counterfactual Fair Opportunity: Measuring Decision Model Fairness with Counterfactual Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any benchmarks related to faith or religion. The study focuses on measuring fairness in machine learning models concerning gender, race, and marital status using counterfactual reasoning.
findings: The paper did not have any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
